timeline.title: The New Year's Secret — C → D → E → E-F01
timeline.summary: Meenakshi privately prepares Nikhil's evening roleplay surprise while managing her lactation routine. Mohan, an unrelated household guest, notices her morning dress and the pouch; his one-sided curiosity culminates in unauthorized inspection and reader-only fantasy.
timeline.detail: C (06:40–06:55): plum front-button kurta, cream palazzo, grey cardigan; private milk-expression routine; pouch with bold black-lace adult roleplay costume set (teddy plus matching panties) and silk blindfold, intended for husband Nikhil. D (~06:56–07:10): familiar Uncle ji teasing; Mohan's gaze lingers on Meenakshi's chest and he jokes about Vihaan's feeding schedule; she blushes with amusement, not reciprocal attraction. He sees the pouch and asks; she shyly deflects. E (07:15–07:24): Mohan enters her room and opens the pouch without consent, later imagines her in costume while alone; the fantasy ends explicitly with a return to reality. Meenakshi is not physically present and is unaware. M01-F02 (07:24–07:37) after the fantasy and return to reality: Meenakshi hums inside the bathroom; Mohan near the corridor observes only an indistinct shadow through frosted glass, with no clear body view, then leaves. Meenakshi is unaware. Getting ready (07:37–07:40): nursing bra, plum front-button kurta, cream palazzo, open grey cardigan, one-shoulder dupatta, earrings, watch, hospital bag. Costume set and blindfold remain in private pouch for Nikhil, never hospital attire.

timeline.title: Preparation Before Rounds — Cleaning Sign and Unnoticed Presence
timeline.summary: Meenakshi overlooks the yellow cleaning board, believes the changing area is empty, completes her private 8–10 minute milk-expression routine and changes into clinical attire while staff Harish Pal and Sunil Yadav remain behind the partition. She does not hear their warning, secures her locker at 09:00–09:05, and leaves for rounds at 09:05 unaware.
timeline.detail: 08:46 yellow CLEANING IN PROGRESS — PLEASE WAIT sign outside. Meenakshi, focused on her 09:05 rounds, enters, puts bag on bench, silences phone and removes watch. From her own point of view the room seems empty, although Harish and Sunil are behind partition. Sunil quietly informs Harish then calls out that cleaning is underway; Meenakshi does not hear clearly. User supplied detailed nursing/pumping prose: she removes plum kurta and bra, places breast-pump flanges, runs the suction to express milk, monitors storage bottle, completes after about 8–10 minutes, removes equipment and wipes skin; physiological sensitivity and relief are included in the published source wording. Workers improperly remain throughout the routine and changing, but do not announce themselves effectively. At around 09:00 she changes into fresh bra and professional hospital clothes, puts on white coat, straightens ID/hair and stethoscope, secures all personal items and pump kit in the locked locker. She leaves at 09:05 with no knowledge of the workers' presence. Later a colleague will tell her, in a separate unapproved scene. Preserve exact knowledge states and one exit ending.

timeline.title: A Passing Curiosity at the Locker
timeline.summary: At 13:10 Meenakshi briefly notices a different cardigan fold and shifted pouch, wonders whether she placed them that way, puts her things straight, closes the locker and immediately returns to her hospital duties. No photo is taken; the small question leaves her mind shortly afterward. POV ends at 13:15.
timeline.detail: 13:10 PM. Meenakshi staff locker ke paas aayi. Cardigan ka fold kuch alag laga aur pouch shelf par thoda khiska hua tha. Meenakshi (halke se): “Arre, yeh maine yahan rakha tha kya?” Usne ek pal cheezein dekhin. Sab kuch wahi maujood tha. “Shayad subah jaldi mein aise hi rakh diya hoga.” Usne cardigan theek se rakha, locker band kiya aur key apne bag mein rakh li. 13:15 PM. Meenakshi apne hospital duties par laut gayi. Kuch hi der mein uska dhyan agle kaam par chala gaya aur locker wali baat uske zehan se nikal gayi.
notes: Replacement ending approved by author for synchronization; no phone photograph, evidence log, suspicion investigation or lingering anxiety.
